[SWS_CM_00234] Behavior of a ServiceSkeleton over a secure channel using an unreliable transport protocol before the secure channel is established
⌈
The middleware shall ensure a secure channel has been successfully established for
each proxy, for which a secure channel is configured before sending data.
Therefore, invocation of the following methods shall not result in sending data to a
proxy for which a secure channel is configured but not established:
• the Send() method of the respective Event class (see [SWS_CM_00162])
• the Send() method of the respective Trigger class (see [SWS_CM_00721])
• the Update() method of the respective Field class (see [SWS_CM_00119])
⌋
